festival.name: Association for Israel Studies Annual Conference

ticketing.notes: Registration for the general public through the conference's EventAct registration page: faculty $180, non-faculty $120, students $90 (the conference page's own figures). Presenters must also be current AIS members.

venues.name: Ramat Gan Academic College
venues.notes: The 2026 host (the conference page and the agenda's own header name it). The agenda runs eleven halls, numbered 1 to 11, which it does not map onto the college's own rooms, so no seat count is served for a hall. The college's own site did not answer when this was researched, so no street address is served.
